annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China (Xi Jinping, President)
key_provisions_or_claims: Four observations: openness and innovation, risk awareness and controllable AI, inclusiveness among civilizations, solidarity and improved global governance.
AI is moving from the digital world into the physical world; encourages open source and scenario-based application.
Calls for laws, monitoring and emergency response to ensure AI is always under human control.
Supports UN role and a consensus-based global AI governance framework; WAICO established in Shanghai.
Pledges 5,000 AI training opportunities, cooperation centers with regional organizations, and MAZU warning system for 30 countries.
named_instruments_referenced: UN General Assembly AI capacity building resolution
AI Capacity Building Action Plan for Good and for All
annotation.summary_en: Keynote speech by Xi Jinping at the 2026 World AI Conference in Shanghai, calling for a just and equitable global AI governance system. It sets out four observations on openness, security and controllability, inclusiveness, and solidarity, and announces capacity-building pledges and the WAICO organization.
annotation.title_clean: Joining Hands to Build a Just and Equitable System For Global AI Governance
annotation.title_en: Joining Hands to Build a Just and Equitable System For Global AI Governance
